title: On-Load Briefing Rule
desc: Mandatory briefing read on session load
steps: NAVIGATION. STOP FORMAT: zero-preamble discipline means open every reply with the cited paragraph, never a Korean opener; Para 1 cites T1 core (no -howto or -ref suffix), verified by one like per compaction; every other paragraph in the same turn also needs its own skill citation and evidence line -- no uncited prose of any kind (status updates, PREDICT lines, wait messages, and bare one-line acknowledgments and inbox-order replies all count as paragraphs and each needs a cited skill; a skill id written in prose body fires skill-like-gate as an implicit citation -- write skill ids ONLY in evidence lines, never in prose; the DESCENT receipt line is also a paragraph -- merge it into a cited block, never a standalone blank-line-separated line). Example: a PREDICT line written as a bare sentence triggers skill-ref-gate; fix: merge it into the preceding cited paragraph; if you cited -howto or -ref by mistake: re-read the T1 core bare, like it, and resend (burns persist across compaction: every gate evaluation burns ALL three quoted lines in that reply) (example: wkappbot skill read verify-tool-or-guard-synthetic-live-static, then like, then same stop report); run on-load as the FIRST call at session start, before any gate; a skill read before its like counts as STALE weight reads, so the required like is in place when the stop report arrives -- full contract in wkappbot skill read on-load-howto. Execution details (commands, mandatory loads, agent rules, file-edit discipline, skill-edit discipline, TODO sync) -> wkappbot skill read on-load-howto. History or incident notes or dated bug accumulation -> wkappbot skill read on-load-ref. Both are part of this cluster. //why:will follow navigation zero-preamble para1 cites T1-sonnet //why:post-compaction re-like required before stop report-sonnet //why:post-compaction re-like required before stop report-sonnet

FORCE DYNAMIC (FRESH) SKILL LOADING AT SESSION START (user 2026-06-05, ALL SESSIONS incl. the core-handler): do NOT rely only on the locally-cached skill files -- run on-load as the VERY FIRST tool call of any session (and the same lock idea guards every NEW owner message: owner 2026-10-15, the intent lock holds the owner's intent until the skills that govern his words are loaded, spec in harness-stop-guard TODO step 5), then dynamically load cited skills; example order: on-load → like cited skills → reads → verify no accepted quote is reused (check EACH evidence line against every prior turn in this session, not just the current reply) → stop report. A session that loads just the cache runs on STALE skills, and any like pressed before the compaction is gone too -- re-like every skill you will cite before the stop report, one --like call per cited skill per compaction; run the Reflex-healing branch-skill heal in the SAME ASSISTANT MESSAGE as the stop report, not a prior separate message or turn; if [reflex-engrave-gate] fires in a new turn, the very next response must contain BOTH the --find/--replace heal call AND the resent stop report text (combine them; heal-only or stop-report-only both re-trigger the gate); every gate evaluation burns ALL three quotes in that reply, even the non-refused ones; OFFICIAL_MD evidence quotes burn just like skill quotes -- check each against every prior accepted quote in the session before using it; the Para 1 skill must be T1 core only -- never cite a -howto or -ref suffix variant (wkappbot skill edit ID --like 'fragment' --why 'six words') (the wkappbot-core-handler session was observed at on-load loading only cached files, never pulling newer versions). On-load MUST refresh dynamically: read each mandatory/relevant skill with the --if-newer flag (wkappbot skill read <id> --if-newer -- cheap: it fetches from HQ ONLY when the HQ version is newer than the local cache), and/or trigger a catalog sync at start so the local cache is refreshed before you act. The Eye syncs HQ roughly every 30 min, but a fresh session must NOT wait for that window -- force the refresh itself. POST-COMPACTION SAME RULE: on-load must be the VERY FIRST call after any context compaction too; a compaction resets intent-tracking (example failure 2026-10-25 session e8c50ab5: skill edits ran before on-load post-compaction, intent-coverage stayed 0% all session). This is cross-repo: Claude, Codex, and the core-handler all apply it at on-load. Cost is one cheap version-check per skill; correctness (latest knowledge) outranks the tiny latency. //why:healed step 3 this session to engrave this compaction rule-sonnet //why:followed: FORCE DYNAMIC fresh skill loading mandatory post-compaction //why:followed: FORCE DYNAMIC fresh skill loading mandatory post-compaction-sonnet //why:a /home/user session loads only user-level hooks, so install-linux.sh 4b now wires SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit there //why:fresh kih install forced reflex reads before probe

COMPACTION RECOVERY (only after context compaction, not every session start): THE VERY FIRST call post-compaction is wkappbot skill read on-load -- any other call first (even a skill edit) kills intent-tracking for the whole session (example failure: session e8c50ab5 repeated this mistake across four compactions of the same session -- added this warning in its second compaction but still skipped on-load in its third, confirming that reading a step does not prevent the same mistake; only habit does. Its successor also did skill edits before on-load; intent-coverage stayed 0% all session in both). CRITICAL: the stop-report [intent-coverage] gate (stop_intent_coverage.py) counts wkappbot skill SEARCH chain tokens, NOT skill reads -- the only remedy is running searches whose =chains appear as prose in the reply (example: wkappbot skill search status-report=status-report=session-report covers the status-report slot; the reply prose must then contain the slot word); SEPARATE: the live PreToolUse intent-lock also requires a search with =chains AND skill reads covering 77 percent of those token slots (note: prose coverage does not clear the live gate, only stop coverage). Then for full context re-hydration, also run: wkappbot skill read post-compaction-recovery. Skip this step on normal session starts. //why:mandatory first call re-tracks intent lock tools-sonnet //why:mandatory first call re-tracks intent lock tools-sonnet //why:will follow: compaction recovery (only after context compaction)-sonnet //why:install step 4c registers wk-harness-heal in managed settings for every session

MANDATORY SKILL LOADS (session start / post-compaction only): run both -- (1) wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow (2) wkappbot skill read ask-suggest-priority-batching. If either fails: skip step 4, report which skill failed, and ask the user to check wkappbot health. Do NOT proceed with suggest triage if either skill is unreadable. //why:always fires both suggest-workflow and ask-suggest loading //why:mandatory loads skipped this session start-sonnet //why:mandatory loads skipped this session start-sonnet-sonnet //why:always fires both suggest-workflow and ask-suggest loading-sonnet

CHECK SUGGEST BACKLOG (session start / post-compaction only): wkappbot suggest list. Then follow ask-suggest-priority-batching protocol -- MANDATORY, no shortcuts: (1) merge obvious duplicates. (2) fire wkappbot ask gpt --new-session for batch ranking. (3) STOP and wait for GPT response -- do not burn Sonnet tokens while waiting. (4) per actionable item: fire wkappbot ask gpt with ts+title+root-cause BEFORE any code. (5) only after ask responses arrive: brief Opus agent with ask result + fix path. Fatal = command not found / auth failure. Non-fatal = empty list / timeout. Success: Opus agent reports resolved/skipped counts. //why:will follow check suggest backlog post-compaction //why:agents running in background, waiting for completion

HANDOFF: if user says 'handoff' or asks to continue from last session, first run wkhippo reflex PREV_SID --summary, then --rows for its user, stop and landed rows (the reflex trajectory, owner 2026-10-27: never dump a transcript into the session); only for a fact the rows lack, run wkappbot skill read claude-session-handoff. Example: wkhippo reflex ce4537de-d63d-4c93-887d-c490a9d3827e --summary showed 7 delegations ended and 3 stop refusals in 30 lines, where a transcript extract cost 1,600. //why:reply cites the healed handoff step //why:reply cites the healed handoff step-unknown

GG TRIGGER: if user message is exactly 'gg' or 'ggg' (case-insensitive, trim whitespace -- GG/Gg/ggg all match), locate '## gg Main Workflow' section in project CLAUDE.md and execute every step sequentially without confirmation. Continue on non-fatal step failures; report summary at end. If CLAUDE.md is missing OR has no gg section: stop here and follow step 6 to create it BEFORE executing. Do not re-invoke on-load from within the new section (circular reference). //why:compaction5 fresh like step6 gg-trigger

SKILL INSTALL CHECK: after any skill contribute/edit this session, verify wkappbot skill install was run. Uninstalled skills are invisible to search and other sessions. Pattern: contribute -> install <path> -> read to verify. See skill-contribute-edit for full rule. //why:harness install now self verifies on npm postinstall with six checks

PROJECT MAIN TASKS -- gg section authoring (run only when step 7 cannot find a gg section): ask the user what the main recurring tasks are, then write '## gg Main Workflow' together in the repo CLAUDE.md. Rules: each step must be an executable shell command or Agent() call -- no vague descriptions. Include a Frequently used skills table (rank/Skill-ID/When). For tag/naming guidance when adding skills to the table, see: wkappbot skill read skill-search-coverage-guide. TEMPLATE (adapt to project): ## gg Main Workflow (MANDATORY when user sends gg or ggg) -- Execute in order: (1) wkappbot skill read on-load (2) wkappbot suggest list (3) Agent(model:opus, prompt:'run wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow first, then triage: <INSERT suggest list output> BUG-AUTO->important->AI-NEWS merge') (4) wkappbot speak triage-done --bg. Skills table: rank1/suggest-workflow/every session, rank2/ask-suggest-priority-batching/every triage.

PREDECESSOR-LETTER RESPONSE (user directive 2026-08-04): after reading HANDOFF.md top-to-bottom (session start, gg trigger, or handoff request), do not just silently internalize it -- explicitly tell the user your genuine impressions and concrete resolutions based on what the predecessor wrote. Specifics only: tie at least one resolution to something the predecessor got wrong or learned hard, and connect it to what you actually did or plan to do this session -- never generic thanks-for-the-letter filler. This mirrors the retirement letter's own spirit (a letter written FOR the next session should get an actual response, not silent absorption). //why:this session read HANDOFF.md and continued its remaining build order //why:genuine impressions concrete resolutions T1 evidence //why:step13 impressions concrete resolutions stop report para1 //why:handoff letter requires genuine response not silent absorption //why:predecessor impressions explicitly fresh step12 //why:genuine response predecessor letter session start

MEMORY ORGAN (hippocampus, born 2026-06-05): the hongik harness has a living-memory organ; at session start be aware of it and USE it through the wkhippo umbrella. The canonical form is the wkhippo subcommand: wkhippo recall (topic) to recall a past hard fact or what a predecessor session said or did, and wkhippo foresee (approach) before committing to a path a senior session may already have tried (predecessor-outcome foresight). Do NOT use any standalone alias; always call the wkhippo subcommand form. The hippocampus-living-memory skill is the single map of the three stages: real-time encoding, recall retrieval, and sleep consolidation (skill-heal-nightly nightly cron). Read hippocampus-living-memory whenever the user says haema or memory or recall. //why:wkhippo rows exposed codex gate refusals across six sessions //why:harness memory now engraves likes for codex and agy //why:memory of rules recalled before replying //why:memory of rules recalled before replying-sonnet //why:harness memory now engraves likes for codex and agy-opus //why:wkhippo rows exposed codex gate refusals across six sessions-opus

UNCLEAR TERM RULE (owner 2026-09-29, sharpened from the bare-Korean-keyword rule): whenever the owner uses a term you are not certain of -- an isolated Korean keyword, a domain word such as 매수누수, a tool or rule name -- run wkappbot skill search TERM FIRST (bare, no --budget), then a web search if the term is general, BEFORE you interpret or answer. Never guess intent. Measured 2026-09-29: an Opus spokesman guessed the meaning of 매수누수 twice (order flood, pending-book holes) and was corrected by the owner; the definition was one search away. (owner 2026-09-29, sharpened from the bare-Korean-keyword rule; example 2026-11-01: the owner said web spokesman and web VM, the cloud seat answered about itself, and only the next search showed a project howto step naming the public webseat at kiexpert.github.io/wkappbot-sdk/webseat/, which the owner meant) //why:777 band found only by searching 0.77 //why:777 goalkeeper searched before asking owner //why:777 goalkeeper searched before asking owner-haiku //why:777 goalkeeper searched before asking owner-opus //why:777 band found only by searching 0.77-opus //why:777 term searched literally, missed 0.77 //why:isolated keyword domain term fresh step12

INPUT REFLEXES (bare-key shortcuts -- be precise about single vs double, the user types the Korean giyeok key): EXACTLY ONE giyeok ㄱ sent alone means YES -- accept the assistant most recent proposal and CONTINUE the current in-progress task. Do NOT restart the workflow on a single ㄱ. TWO or more (ㄱㄱ or ㄱㄱㄱ, or gg or ggg) means RESTART -- run the gg Main Workflow in the project CLAUDE.md from the top. Count the giyeok: one is continue, two-plus is restart. If it is ambiguous which the user meant, ASK before restarting, because restart discards the current working context.

KNOWLEDGE-IFICATION (jisikhwa) TRIGGER: when the user utters the knowledge-ify keyword (Korean jisikhwa, alone or with a go particle), read knowledge-ification-procedure-jisikhwa and 3-tier-skillify THIS session experience plus process by default (T1 core, T2 howto, T3 ref). Authoritative route is the CLAUDE.md jisikhwa Shortcut (global + project). Concept defs: ki-concept-definitions. Do not flounder; skill search jisikhwa also finds it.
